answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7590 Country: India Title: I have taken one of my friend to a hospital who is a non-muslim. At the time of giving injection to him, can I pray for him by saying ya shafi ya kafi. pl. clarify this point. Question: I have taken one of my friend to a hospital who is a non-muslim. At the time of giving injection to him, can I pray for him by saying ya shafi ya kafi. pl. clarify this point. Answer ID: 7590 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1068/1065=M/1429) You cave injection by saying ya shafi ya kafi, there is no wrong in it, it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
